scope.goal: Track npm and pnpm conformance for browser guest runtime productization.

cases.notes: Guest runner now classifies the command as version and keeps non-version npm paths behind ERR_PM_REAL_CLI_EVALUATION_REQUIRED until real CLI module evaluation is wired.
Guest runner now classifies the command as version and keeps non-version pnpm paths behind ERR_PM_REAL_CLI_EVALUATION_REQUIRED until real CLI module evaluation is wired.
Validates virtual store, workspace links, bin links, frozen lockfile invariants, and copy-fallback node_modules materialization from a native pnpm fixture.

cases.command: vendored CLI static require graph preflight
cases.notes: Walks vendored npm and pnpm entry module graphs, resolves simple computed path entries, expands npm install/ci/run/exec command dispatch, resolves npmPath package metadata probes, classifies Keyv adapter loading as optional for the default browser runtime store path, handles JSON modules, ignores string/comment false positives, rejects missing package modules, verifies there are no static unsupported builtin gaps, and counts only optional probes after product-scope graph expansion.

cases.productGap: Browser runtime can validate and materialize local file dependency install layout with copy-fallback links. Full npm dependency graph execution still needs real CLI module evaluation.
Browser runtime applies the frozen local-file install plan for ci. Full npm cli ci evaluation still needs the vendored CLI module evaluator; host Node remains only as the reference comparator.

Browser runtime now validates fixture build script, lifecycle marker script, bin exec, and interrupted install-plan recovery through script-runner-application. Full npm lifecycle process spawning, peer resolver execution, and optional package policy still need real CLI module evaluation.
Browser runtime can validate and materialize workspace-only frozen install layout with copy-fallback links. Full pnpm dependency graph execution still needs real CLI module evaluation.

Browser runtime now validates fixture build script, lifecycle marker script, bin exec, and interrupted install-plan recovery through script-runner-application. Full pnpm lifecycle process spawning, peer resolver execution, and optional package policy still need real CLI module evaluation.

gate.reason: Version boot, local install layout, npm ci plan application, store plan, script-runner-application run/exec/lifecycle fixture, interrupted install-plan recovery, tarball cache paths, and product-scope static CLI graph classification pass or partially pass in browser guest runtime, but full npm/pnpm CLI module evaluation still depends on host-node-test-helper as the reference comparator. Static graph classification now covers simple computed entries, JSON modules, npm install/ci/run/exec command dispatch, npm config metadata probes, pnpm Keyv adapter optional loading, child_process diagnostics, crypto hashing/random subset, dns, fs/promises, http/https, http2 diagnostics, net/tls unsupported diagnostics, worker_threads diagnostics, and lightweight constants/querystring/readline/string_decoder/timers/v8 builtins. Remaining blocker is moving real npm/pnpm CLI evaluation off the host-node-test-helper before product support.
